verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX developer page says the card's FP8 Transformer Engine accelerates AI development across TensorFlow and PyTorch. That is a direct but marketing-level claim of mainstream framework support. A community critic notes the card is SM120, without tmem/tcgen05, and that main libraries focus on SM100/B300, so framework-level optimization may lag; this is not a hands-on failure of PyTorch running, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: officially documented PyTorch/TensorFlow builds for this GPU, a published support matrix listing the RTX PRO 6000/SM120 with CUDA and framework versions, and independent hands-on confirmation of framework compatibility.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, PyTorch and mainstream ML frameworks run on this GPU through officially documented builds and support matrices

citations.quote: accelerates LLM prototyping, inference, and AI development across frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch
